document.abstract: Up to a recent date, background process work had been limited to the size of a picture that could be successfully illuminated through a single projecting machine. The origination of a combination of projectors superimposing identical prints of the same background on the screen simultaneously compounded the light delivery of a single machine and therefore greatly expanded the scope of background process photography for natural color and black-and-white.
